UPDATE material_attachment SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected}

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(reserved_bytes) FROM material_upload WHERE owner_id=#{owner}),0)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(reserved_bytes) FROM material_parse_run WHERE owner_id=#{owner}),0)

SELECT FROM material_upload WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND attachment_id=#{id} ORDER BY created_at,id

UPDATE material_upload SET status=#{status},received_bytes=#{received},error_code=#{error},finished_at=#{now},lease_until=NULL WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND status='RECEIVING' AND claim_token=#{token} AND lease_until>#{now}
